resumeText:
Prakash Desai | Thane | prakash.desai@example.com

SUMMARY
IT leader with 17 years running infrastructure and applications for manufacturers.

EXPERIENCE
Senior Manager - IT, Sahyadri Engineering, Thane (2017 - present)
- Wrote the IT strategy and three-year roadmap for six plants.
- Run IT portfolio management for ERP and plant system projects.
- Handle vendor management for 14 IT vendors and contract renewals.
- Run IT service management on ITIL v4 with a 12-person help desk.
- Hold monthly service reviews with vendors against SLAs.
- Control access through Active Directory and MFA for 2,000 users.
- Own backup and recovery and disaster recovery drills.
- Managed a team of 20 across infrastructure, ERP and support.
- Use stakeholder communication with plant heads and finance.

IT Manager, Konkan Auto Parts, Pune (2011 - 2017)
- Ran network, servers and SAP support.

System Engineer, Deccan Infosystems, Pune (2008 - 2011)

EDUCATION
BE Computer Engineering, University of Pune, 2008

CERTIFICATIONS
ITIL 4 Foundation
